image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade or craft-style bib lying on a blue textured fabric background. The bib features a translucent or semi-transparent plastic/vinyl outer layer with colorful stitching around the edges. Inside or printed on the bib is a chaotic, collage-like arrangement of pink yarn balls, green rectangular blocks, and other abstract shapes. A multi-colored strap (orange, green, white) loops at the top for neck fastening.
